messages:
rahul: Quick heads-up  launched Dedicated L4e pools in eu-berlin and ap-jakarta for customers needing low-power, cost-efficient inference. Early availability is limited capacity; opt-in link + docs: https://internal.redwood.ai/dedicated/l4e-availability :loudspeaker:

deploy-bot: rollout started -> eu-berlin-1, ap-jakarta-1. Canary ID: rbw-roll-2167890123. Basic health checks: green.

ops-bot: Note on routing: L4e is tagged as `low-power`. Requests will prefer L4e when `cost_priority=true` and model memory fits. Fallback to standard pools if capacity is exhausted.

clare: Policy Q  are these billed under existing credits or separate SKU?

finance: New SKU `dedicated.l4e.hour` for GA. Preview customers billed under `DED-L4E-PREVIEW` with a small introductory discount. Migration from legacy SKUs requires change order.

anya: Runtime note: no image changes required. Recommend `--enable-l4e-optim` flag for best throughput. Watch for increased small-allocation fragmentation in early runs.

rahul: Known limits: preview cap 6 GPUs/account, no autoscale, preemptible disabled. SRE watchlist: p95 latency, gpu_util, and small allocation failure rate. Suggested alerts: `increase(allocation_failures[5m]) > 0` and `histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(request_duration_bucket[5m])) > 450`

clare: I'll update the support KB and notify partners. Office hours for SRE/sales tomorrow 11:00 UTC.

rahul: Follow-ups: perf microbenchmarks in the docs by EOD, and a targeted outreach to customers with `cost_priority` tag. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
